name: Enterprise Initiative and Business Case
constraints: WM-ACT-030 remains the only Initiative root and its identity survives business-case revisions, gates and rejection.
Idea, request or ticket becomes an Initiative only through explicit registration with case for change, mandate and accountable sponsor.
Formalization into Project, Program or operation mints a new master identity and records typed derivation, scope mapping and handover.
Ticket, approval and budget line never create delivery identity.
Business Case is an immutable versioned release contained by Initiative and is explicitly superseded.
Alternative is an addressable contained appraisal record with its own estimates, uncertainty and risk set.
Every comparison pins one criteria set, horizon, currency, price base, valuation basis and metric revisions.
Option sets include a do-nothing or business-as-usual comparator unless an explicit exception is recorded.
Mandatory and compensatory criteria remain distinct and incomparable dimensions are not netted without a declared method.
Assumption, Hypothesis and Forecast remain distinct and reference their external masters.
Investment Decision binds WM-KNW-010 rationale, WM-ACT-024 occurrence, WM-REC-010 issued record and WM-ECO-012 funding facts.
Mandate, approval, funding authorization, allocation, release, availability and realized benefit remain distinct assertions.
Alternative forecasts sharing one expected benefit identity are mutually contextual and never summed.
Decision reconstruction pins the original input package and preserves rejected initiatives, alternatives and rationale.
Unallocated Outcome, Benefit and Metric referents are never promoted silently.
holds: WM-ACT-030 and adjacent drafts remain non-canonical single-provider results.
The WM-ACT-005 registry parent conflicts with the Initiative-is-not-Project boundary.
Approved relation contracts for initiative, case, option, decision, budget and formalization are absent.
Outcome or Benefit Realization and Metric Definition referents remain unallocated.
Composition coverage, source pins, crosswalks, mastership confirmation and canonical fixtures remain incomplete.
Independent Grok review and one frozen audit remain pending.
